en: Old black‑and‑white panoramic postcard-style photograph of a railway freight yard. A long, low station or warehouse building stands on the left, with multiple rows of boxcars and open freight cars on tracks to the right. The yard is stacked with bales or bundles of goods. A horse‑drawn cart moves along the dirt road in the foreground, and a few small groups of people are visible walking near the station. In the distance are bare trees and a low townscape with scattered two‑ and three‑story buildings on rolling hills. No printed caption or visible handwritten text appears on the image.
